name: Cyclopentyl-Fentanyl
summary: An analogue of fentanyl that is unknown in scientific literature. The drug is suspected to be less potent than its former being Acetyl-Fentanyl. There is limited information on this drug, caution is recommended.

uses.text: Cyclopentylfentanyl is an opioid analgesic that is an analog of fentanyl and has been sold online as a designer drug, mainly in Sweden and other Scandinavian countries.

sideEffects.text: Side effects of fentanyl analogs are similar to those of fentanyl itself, which include itching, nausea and potentially serious respiratory depression, which can be life-threatening. Fentanyl analogs have killed hundreds of people throughout Europe and the former Soviet republics since the most recent resurgence in use began in Estonia in the early 2000s, and novel derivatives continue to appear.

pharmacology.en: Little has been published about it. Like fentanyl, it is presumed to act mainly by activating the mu opioid receptor.
pharmacology.zh: 關於它的發表資料很少。和芬太尼一樣，一般推測它主要透過活化 μ 鴉片類受體發揮作用。
pharmacology.zhHans: 关于它的发表数据很少。和芬太尼一样，一般推测它主要通过活化 μ 鸦片类受体发挥作用。

fact.en: It is fentanyl with a cyclopentane, a five-carbon ring, attached to its amide group. Its relatives cyclopropylfentanyl and cyclobutylfentanyl carry three and four-carbon rings in the same place.
fact.zh: 它是在芬太尼的醯胺基上接了一個五碳環，也就是環戊烷。它的近親環丙基芬太尼與環丁基芬太尼，則在同一位置分別接了三碳環與四碳環。
fact.zhHans: 它是在芬太尼的酰胺基上接了一个五碳环，也就是环戊烷。它的近亲环丙基芬太尼与环丁基芬太尼，则在同一位置分别接了三碳环与四碳环。
